description: This grouped bar chart illustrates GLUE Performance across various Fine-tuning Methods for two different RoBERTa model sizes. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Fine-tuning Method," displaying seven distinct methods from left to right: a visually obscured label covered by a gray shaded rectangle, "Adaptor", "LoRA", "BitFit", "$S_1$-model", "$S_4$-model", and "$S_5$-model". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "GLUE Performance," using a linear scale with numeric tick marks at 86 and 88, indicating an interval of 2, and a visible range extending from approximately 84 to just above 89. The chart features grouped bars, where each fine-tuning method category contains two side-by-side bars representing the "RoBERTa Size," as indicated by the legend. The left bar in each group is colored blue and represents the "base" size, while the right bar is colored orange and represents the "large" size. The blue "base" bars range in approximate value from the shortest at 84.3 for BitFit to the tallest at 87.0 for the $S_5$-model. The orange "large" bars range from approximately 85.6 for the $S_1$-model to the tallest overall bar at 89.2 for the $S_5$-model. Other approximate values include LoRA at 86.6 for base and 88.9 for large, and Adaptor at 84.4 for base and 88.1 for large. The bars do not appear to be sorted in a specific ascending, descending, or alphabetical order, and the only visual emphasis is the aforementioned shading over the first horizontal axis label.
